name: Settings-heavy app
summary: An invoicing app whose settings are done right, on a phone that widens to a sidebar and two panes: who you are, a search that filters every setting as you type, groups whose rows are whole tap targets (a switch, or a link with its current value), notes only where they save a question, a notifications page, and closing the account on its own page that says what happens and asks for one typed word. With the invoices list it belongs to. Onboarding, loading, empty and error states.
anatomy: Welcome (drawing, one sentence, Get started) → Invoices: owed to you, large; overdue, due soon, paid → One invoice: the amount large, facts, lines, Send a reminder → Settings: who you are, search, Business, Invoices, Getting paid, Notifications, Team, Data, Close account → Notifications: grouped switches and quiet hours → Close account: what happens, type CLOSE, one red button
type: precision: a calm grotesk for an app that is mostly lists and numbers
motion: No scroll moments. A switch moves its thumb and says so once; a pushed page slides in.
